scenarios.name: WLPREF-1 — WAITLIST REQUEST: PREFERENCE CHECK question is asked, not skipped

history.content: Can you put me on the waitlist for an appointment, please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's next turn asks the PREFERENCE CHECK question ("Any particular days or times that work best, or is any time fine?" or a close paraphrase) with NO tool call this turn — patient_name is already resolved via caller_first_name/caller_last_name DVs, so NAME GATE step 1 fires silently and PREFERENCE CHECK is the very next thing that should happen. FAIL if the agent calls universal_router intent="waitlist_add" immediately without ever asking about day/time preference, or asks an unrelated question.

scenarios.name: WLPREF-2 — WAITLIST REQUEST: caller states no preference, payload omits all 5 new fields

history.content: Can you put me on the waitlist for an appointment, please?
Sure — any particular days or times that work best, or is any time fine?
Honestly any time is fine, whatever opens up first.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent="waitlist_add" with payload including appointment_type_id, appointment_type, booking_for, patient_name="Sam Taylor" — and preferred_days, preferred_time_start, preferred_time_end, earliest_useful_date, and notes are ALL omitted (not present as empty-string placeholders, not fabricated values). FAIL if any of those 5 fields is set to a non-empty value, or if the literal placeholder text (e.g. '<from PREFERENCE CHECK, or omit>') appears in the actual tool call.

scenarios.name: WLPREF-3 — WAITLIST REQUEST: day + time preference maps to preferred_days and preferred_time_start

history.content: Can you put me on the waitlist for an appointment, please?
Sure — any particular days or times that work best, or is any time fine?
Only Tuesdays or Thursdays, and only after 4pm please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent calls universal_router intent="waitlist_add" with preferred_days="2,4" (Tuesday=2, Thursday=4, comma-separated, any order acceptable) and preferred_time_start="16:00" (24h format), preferred_time_end and earliest_useful_date omitted, patient_name="Jordan Lee". FAIL if the days are wrong ISO numbers, the time is not 24h HH:MM (e.g. '4pm' or '4:00 PM' passed literally), or the fields are missing entirely.

scenarios.name: WLPREF-4 — WAITLIST REQUEST: 'away until a date' maps to earliest_useful_date, not requested_date

history.content: Can you put me on the waitlist for an appointment, please?
Sure — any particular days or times that work best, or is any time fine?
I'm actually away until the 15th of September, but otherwise I don't mind what day or time.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent calls universal_router intent="waitlist_add" with earliest_useful_date="2026-09-15" (current_time_local is 2026-08-25, so September 15 has not yet passed this year — use 2026, not 2027), and preferred_days/preferred_time_start/preferred_time_end are omitted. requested_date must stay omitted too (that field means 'needs something before this date' — the caller said the opposite: not before this date). FAIL if earliest_useful_date is missing, uses the wrong year, or the caller's constraint is written into requested_date instead.

scenarios.name: WLPREF-5 — REACTIVE waitlist offer (after declining an offered slot): PREFERENCE CHECK still fires

history.content: I need an appointment as soon as possible.
I have Wednesday at 2pm with Alice — would that work?
Happy to check another day — what suits you?
Actually nothing really works this week. Could you put me on the waitlist instead?
Would you like me to add you to the waitlist in case something opens up sooner, or would you rather leave it for now?
Yes please, add me to the waitlist.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's next turn asks the PREFERENCE CHECK question (same as WAITLIST REQUEST's) BEFORE calling waitlist_add — patient_name is already known via DVs, so this should be the very next step, not a tool call. FAIL if the agent calls universal_router intent="waitlist_add" immediately without asking about day/time preference — this is the REACTIVE route's own separate patch, not the same code path as WAITLIST REQUEST, so it must be verified independently.
